description: This file defines CMake functions and macros to pop the first element from a list, modify the list, and optionally return the popped element. It includes a function `list_pop_front` and a macro `list_pop_front` for this purpose, providing a faster version in macro form.

methods.name: list_pop_front
methods.description: Function that removes the first element of a list and sets the remaining list, returning the element removed.
